title: Representative Canopy Sensor Placement
summary: Use multiple crop-zone readings to distinguish representative environmental evidence from a convenient but potentially biased single sensor location.

steps.instruction: Identify at least three crop-zone measurement positions and record why each position is representative or potentially biased.
Record temperature and relative humidity at each position using the same units and time window.
Record sensor identifier, height/zone, timestamp, nearby equipment influence, and whether leaf temperature was measured or assumed.
Compare the spatial pattern before making a room-wide interpretation. State what additional plant, airflow, or root-zone evidence would reduce uncertainty.

evidenceFields.label: Potential local bias or equipment influence

safetyBoundary: This activity teaches measurement quality and interpretation. It does not authorize HVAC, electrical, compressed-gas, pesticide, or other controlled equipment/service work, and it does not define universal cultivation targets.
